{"success": true, "data": {"stdout": "# OpenVLA Smart Compress: cross-attention pooling to compress 256 vision tokens -> 128 tokens.
# Trainable: VisionTokenCompressor + LoRA adapters on LLM.

model:
  name: openvla
  pretrained: "/root/autodl-tmp/openvla-libero-object/"
  dtype: "bfloat16"

compressor:
  hidden_dim: 4096
  num_queries: 128
  num_heads: 16
  num_layers: 2
  dropout: 0.1

lora:
  enabled: true
  r: 16
  alpha: 32
  target_modules: ["q_proj", "v_proj"]
  dropout: 0.05

dataset:
  repo_id: "HuggingFaceVLA/libero"
  action_chunk_size: 1
  features:
    state_dim: 8
    action_dim: 7
    cameras:

training:
  total_steps: 100000
  batch_size: 8
  eval_batch_size: 1
  num_workers: 4
  lr: 1.0e-4
  betas: [0.9, 0.95]
  weight_decay: 1.0e-10
